title: Thoughts on what plugins might be of use to me?

posts.author: Scion_of_the_Shadowlight
posts.body:
I just purchased RPG Maker MZ and I'm excited to start working on it. Are there any plugins you would recommend? I’m not necessarily saying I need plugins for the following features, but I wanted to mention them in case the effects I want need be accomplished with plugins:
1. **Changing BGM during battle** – I want the ability to change the BGM during battle, such as when a transformation or major event occurs, and then return to the original music once it's over.
2. **TP Damage or TP Drain** – I’d like to have effects that drain or damage TP, either as an effect on the player or enemies.
3. **Health as a cost for abilities/spells** – An option to use health as a resource for abilities and spells would be helpful.
4. **Percentage-based costs for TP, MP, and Health** – It would be great if I could use a percentage of TP, MP, or Health as a cost for certain spells or abilities.
5. **Summoning temporary characters** – I want to summon temporary characters during battle with a duration, and they should disappear when the battle ends.
6. **Extra party slots** – I’m looking for 4 additional party member slots, which could either be used for extra party members or reserved for summons and guest characters.
7. **Enemy and boss scaling** – I'd like enemies and bosses to scale with the player's level and equipment. For example, a formula like: 100 + (heroLvl * 20) + (10 * (each piece of equipment * equipment tier)).
8. **Battle sprite height adjustment** – While there is a sprite height modifier, it can cause issues in the overworld (like characters appearing in front of and behind objects, such as bushes). However, adjusting sprite height in battle would work fine, so I'd like a plugin that allows me to modify battle sprite height to avoid these visual issues.
9. **Non-traditional buffs/debuffs** – Effects like regenerating HP per turn, casting a specific spell on an enemy when attacked (possibly for free), taking half damage from all sources, or debuffs like enemies taking double damage or losing MP when damaged. I’m looking for creative effects that go beyond the traditional buffs/debuffs.
10. **Buff/Debuff stacking** – I’d like to allow buffs and debuffs to stack up to 4 or 5 times (or possibly more or less, depending on the effect).
11. **Enemies summoning more enemies** – A system where enemies can summon backup or call in reinforcements during battle.
Thanks for taking the time to read this, and any plugin recommendations would be greatly appreciated!

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
Scion_of_the_Shadowlight said:
I just purchased RPG Maker MZ and I'm excited to start working on it.
Click to expand...
That sentence alone tells me that it would be better if you make a very small game completely without plugins first.
The problem you will otherwise have that many plugins assume you already know the defaults of the engine as well as what you want to change. Adding plugins without knowing the basics has a very high chance to confuse you to what is going on.
especially the Visustella plugins allow you to change a lot of different things with each and every plugin, so adding one for one specific feature without even recognizing the other dozen changes will lead to a bad situation, especially if you don't want one of the other features and everyone is guessing where it comes from while telling you that the default doesn't behave that way.
Happened at least half a dozen times in the last few months.
second reason is that everyone needs a learning project that will almost always be scrapped after getting the basics of the engine - starting with your dream project will usually damage that dream as soon as you are forced to scrap that dream project.
So everyone around here will tell you to make a scrap project to learn the basics before trying your dream project.
you might want to follow the link to the starting point for new users in my signature - that tutorial is very old but still valid everywhere.

posts.author: caethyril
posts.body:
I agree with Andar: best to make sure you're familiar with the core engine first, then look for plugins as and when you need them.
In terms of what the basic engine can do:
In a troop event: Save BGM, Play BGM, Replay BGM.
TP damage is possible via states & common events, but a plugin would make it so much easier.
(Requires a custom skill/item cost plugin.)
(Ditto.)
Change Party Member in troop events during battle, and again after battle?
Turn 0, Span Battle troop event: turn switch on;
Parallel common event bound to that switch does after-battle stuff then turns itself off.
Turns can be counted using a variable that you tick down in a Turn 1*X, Span Turn troop event.
Party capacity is already uncapped. You'd need a plugin to increase max battle members.
Is that formula for a skill? Max HP? A generic multiplier to "all" params (if so, which ones)? Etc.
Battle sprites have no size restrictions, just enlarge the spritesheet.
"HP% regen" and "Physical/Magical Hit damage rate" can be applied to a state via traits.
For cast-when hit effects you'd want a plugin, e.g. eval tags or custom counter attacks.
By default (de)buffs stack up to two times (-2 to +2), but states do not stack.
Available in limited form using the Appear Mid-Battle option + Enemy Appear command.
Plugin ideas:
For point 9, ATT_Turan's Eval Tags and/or triacontane's CounterExtend may help:
Eval Tags MZ
Eval Tags 2.0 ATT_Turan  Introduction I have found I often recommend plugins to people solely for the ability to use notetags to execute code at times when events are not accessible. However, there are situations where those plugins include many other features that the user may not want in their...

github.com
For points 2, 3, 4, (7?), 10, and 11, I have a plugin called Cae_Tweaks that could help:
MZ - Cae_Tweaks - lots of little features
Cae_Tweaks v19 updated 2026-06-16 (UTC+0)  Terms of Use MIT License: https://opensource.org/licenses/mit-license.html  Description The plugin file must be named Cae_Tweaks.js.  This plugin contains a bunch of different things. It's mostly just me slowly making a game and coding some more stuff...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
Features M23, M29, M29, (M16?), M22, and D20 respectively. M23 just inverts TP Gain effects, so it might not suffice for how you want to use it.
Alternatively, like Andar mentioned, I'm guessing VisuStella's free core plugins could resolve all/most of these (
blog post
). Be warned that while VisuStella's plugins are widely used and feature-rich, their code is obfuscated. In practice, that means that you may have trouble getting code-level support, e.g. for conflicts with other plugins.
There are probably many options available, both in terms of design and how to achieve it~

posts.author: Aerosys
posts.body:
Scion_of_the_Shadowlight said:
5. **Summoning temporary characters** – I want to summon temporary characters during battle with a duration, and they should disappear when the battle ends.
6. **Extra party slots** – I’m looking for 4 additional party member slots, which could either be used for extra party members or reserved for summons and guest characters.
Click to expand...
Tip: My plugin, which was already linked here, already supports extra slots for summons, so you don't have to worry about them by yourself. And I warn you, don't even think about dynamically adjusting extra slots during battle by yourself - RPG Maker's code isn't well prepared for this. I spent several hours figuring out why sprites aren't appearing, windows are shifted, and even more side effects.
